messages:
Priya: HyperGrid engineering pinged — they want a joint perf-per-watt + kernel-tuning benchmark for Atlas-13B to support a cloud marketplace listing and a co-authored blog. Can we outline requirements and a quick timeline?

Luca: I can lead kernel tuning. We should decide on the knobs: power caps, SM clocks, cudnn heuristics, and tensor core mixed-precision settings. Also need device-level power telemetry (DCIM or IPMI).

Eli: Ill handle the bench infra. Prefer to run 3 repeats per config, seq lengths [64,512], batch sizes [1,8,16]. Our standard command is:

```
./bench/run.sh --model atlas-13b --quant q4_0 --seq 512 --batch 8 --iters 120 --power-monitor ipmi --out=artifacts/hypergrid/roundA
```

Ensure NTP sync and GPU driver pinned.

Ben: Marketing note: HyperGrid requires number embargo + pre-approval on quotes. Legal wants an approval flow. We can publish a joint marketplace page after signoff.

Luca: For the tuning matrix I propose sweeping: power_cap={180, 220, 260}, max_sm_clock={default, +3%, +6%}, and two conv heuristics. Will log per-GPU clocks, PCIe, and host power.

Priya: Great. Can HyperGrid provide wall-meter data or only GPU draw? Wall-meter preferred for perf/W. If not available, we'll document methodology and include an estimated system overhead.

Eli: Also request that HyperGrid reserve a low-noise test window to avoid noisy tenant workloads. Our suggested window: Thu 02:00-06:00 UTC.

Ben: Also pre-agree on the evaluation prompts and pass/fail quality thresholds. I suggest 400 eval prompts + 50 adversarial hallucination checks. Report quality delta vs baseline bfloat16.

Luca: One more technical ask: well need mountable SSH keys and sudo for perf tooling. And access to their kernel logs (dmesg) for any OOM/truncation debugging.

Priya: Action items: (1) Priya to confirm test window with HyperGrid; (2) Luca to draft tuning matrix and configs; (3) Eli to prepare bench infra + CI reproducibility artifact; (4) Ben to coordinate approval flow and eval subset.

Eli: I'll create the S3 bucket path and upload run artifacts: s3://redwood-partners/hypergrid/atlas13b/roundA. CI job PR in ~4h.

deploy-bot: bench-cluster/hypergrid-test will be provisioned at 2025-11-20T02:05Z. Image: rwd/bench:20251120.

Luca: Will upload tuning matrix doc by EOD Monday.

Ben: I'll draft the approval checklist and share for review.

Priya: Thanks all. Let's do a quick sync day-of-test 30 minutes before start. :thumbsup:
